title: Father, I adore You –
lyrics_original: Father, I adore You – Lay my life before You
How I love You, – Spirit, I adore You
Lay my life before You – How I love You
Jesus, I adore You – Lay my life before You

bible_verses.english: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your reasonable service.
Bless Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, bless his holy name!

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, Jesus, and Holy Spirit, I adore You with all my heart today. I freely lay my life, my plans, and my worries at Your feet as an offering of love. Teach me to walk in full surrender, honoring You in everything I do. Thank You for Your endless grace and for receiving my humble worship. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Heavenly Father, Jesus, and Holy Spirit, I adore You with all my heart today. I freely lay my life, my plans, and my worries at Your feet as an offering of love. devotional.reflection_english: This gentle hymn invites us into a simple yet profound posture of worship before the Triune God—Father, Spirit, and Son. As we sing these tender words, we are reminded that true adoration goes beyond mere song; it calls us to offer our entire lives as a living sacrifice of love. In every moment, we can yield our desires, hopes, and daily walk to the One who loves us unconditionally. May your heart find quiet rest and deep joy today as you surrender everything to Him.
